mapper.sql: CASE WHEN ro.status = 'CANCELED' THEN 'CANCELED' WHEN xo.order_status IN ('21', '22') THEN 'SHIPPED' WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM rental_device_assignment a WHERE a.tenant_id = ro.tenant_id AND a.rental_order_id = ro.id AND a.deleted = b'0' AND a.status IN ('DISPATCHED', 'DISPATCHED_PENDING_PLAN', 'RETURNED')) THEN CASE WHEN (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM rental_device_assignment a WHERE a.tenant_id = ro.tenant_id AND a.rental_order_id = ro.id AND a.deleted = b'0' AND a.status IN ('DISPATCHED', 'DISPATCHED_PENDING_PLAN', 'RETURNED')) >= (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(i.quantity), 0) FROM rental_order_item i WHERE i.tenant_id = ro.tenant_id AND i.rental_order_id = ro.id AND i.deleted = b'0') THEN 'SHIPPED' ELSE 'PARTIAL' END ELSE 'UNSHIPPED' END
